text: The Project Director, Business Transformation and Citywide Priorities, Toronto Building will provide a presentation on amendments to the City of Toronto's Sign By-law, adopted by City Council in the spring of 2024, with a focus on its impact on variance requests and applications.
The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Directed that the Confidential Presentation from Toronto Building remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to the education or training of the Members.
